operations.body: Sequencing decided 2026-11-16: this now comes after "Run the board behind a sign-in proxy". Hosting is built and tested first with a server credential that can reach the whole code repository. This story then adds the option some deployments need: a second repository that holds only Workbook refs, so a hosted board's credential opens tasks and nothing else. For that it has to let a code checkout share its tasks through a remote other than origin, and treat a repository holding only Workbook refs as a supported remote.
